page: UpCloud PREMIUM-48xCPU-256GB is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Premium family. It features 48 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor with x86_64 architecture, running at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 48 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio on a shared CPU allocation model. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing 5.33 GB of memory per core, and includes 500 GB of local SSD storage alongside one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results show top-tier single-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 3631.57 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2548.0, both placing in the top 10% of tested servers. Multi-core performance is also highly competitive, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 23628.0 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 91465.13. The server excels in software compilation and image processing, both ranking in the top 10%. However, memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks falls into the average tier, with 62.46 GB/sec read and 63.91 GB/sec write speeds.

While the server demonstrates strong capabilities in cryptography, database operations, and static web serving, its LLM inference capabilities are mixed. Prompt processing for medium 7B models is weak at 17.86 tokens/sec, though text generation for the same model is average at 23.33 tokens/sec. This server is highly suited for general-purpose workloads, software development pipelines, database hosting, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, offering a balanced resource density of compute and memory without dedicated GPU acceleration.
